rules.name: skip_low_vix
rules.reason: In complacent, very low-volatility markets breakdowns tend to get bought back, so the retest short stops out instead of reaching 0.75 ATR; VIX at or below about 11 was the worst bucket (54% win, -0.40% mean).

rules.name: skip_stale_results
rules.reason: More than ~9 weeks since the last results means the next results window is near and the breakdown lacks fresh fundamental drive; this bucket won only 60% with a negative mean.
